mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.content, a.category_id, a.status, a.item_type, a.event_time, a.location, a.resolution_status, a.published_at, a.deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET deleted=1, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND deleted = 0 AND author_id != #{reviewerId} ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET title = #{article.title}, content = #{article.content}, item_type = #{article.itemType}, category_id = #{article.categoryId}, event_time = #{article.eventTime}, location = #{article.location}, contact_info = #{article.contactInfo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{article.id} AND author_id = #{article.authorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('DRAFT','REJECTED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, category_id, status, item_type, event_time, location, contact_info, resolution_status, resolved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version FROM cms_article WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET resolution_status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND resolution_status = 'OPEN' AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
